name: Thukpa
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large pot and sauté minced ginger, garlic, green chilies, and onions until fragrant.
2. Add the chicken or chopped vegetables and cook until browned or tender.
3. Add the shredded cabbage and carrots, sautéing briefly.
4. Pour in the broth and bring it to a boil, adding soy sauce, salt, and crushed Szechuan pepper.
5. Add the fresh noodles to the boiling broth and cook until tender.
6. Garnish generously with chopped spring onions and serve piping hot.
description: Thukpa is a staple comfort food in the Himalayan regions of Arunachal Pradesh. Influenced by Tibetan culture, this warming noodle soup is essential during cold weather, often served as a complete meal that brings families together.
